summary: Quenverell proposal QV.23.100 (September 2023) to Corvenlith Therapeutics, a Boston biotech: reanalysis of immune-cell RNA-seq with donor adjustment and omics target prioritisation. Fixed price £54,400; interim readout after the data acceptance step.

title_block.title: Immune-cell RNA-seq reanalysis and target ranking
title_block.subtitle: Proposal for Corvenlith Therapeutics
lines: Prepared by: Dr T. Zawiernicki, Head of Bioinformatics

blocks.p: Corvenlith Therapeutics has RNA-seq from stimulated immune cells from healthy and patient donors and a candidate list of inflammatory targets. The question is which candidates remain differentially expressed once donor-to-donor variation is accounted for.

list: Client-supplied FASTQ files and sample manifest
Donor, batch and stimulation metadata reconciled against the manifest before any analysis
Public reference expression data for tissue context
Data acceptance: read QC, sample identity checks, outlier review
RNA-seq differential expression with donor as a blocking factor
Sensitivity analysis: results with and without the two flagged donors
Omics target prioritisation: evidence score per candidate combining expression, pathway context and tissue specificity

blocks.p: Model uncertainty will be reported plainly; candidates whose ranking depends on a single donor will be flagged rather than dropped.

list: Data acceptance note and interim readout (about 3 weeks after data receipt)
Final readout deck and ranked target cards
Analysis notebook and versioned pipeline record

blocks.p: Fixed price, excluding VAT. Additional datasets quoted separately.

Corvenlith Therapeutics is a new client for Quenverell. Please note the client name when raising the purchase order: our accounts team has previously confused it with an unrelated group account of similar spelling.
